nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
nodes.rationale: SDD inverts the power structure: specs don't serve code, code serves specs. Spec is the source of truth, written first. AI generates code from specs. Debugging means fixing the spec. Trade-offs: powerful for 3-8 point features and greenfield, but 'sledgehammer for a nut' on small bug fixes, can create false sense of control, and reviewing markdown is harder than reviewing code.
